versions.changelog:
Initial release: Comprehensive migration guide for transitioning from Microsoft Outlook (Office 365, Exchange, PST) to Google Workspace (Gmail).

- Supports migration of email, contacts, and calendars for both single-user and bulk/org-wide projects.
- Details recommended tools and processes for each source: O365/Exchange Online, on-prem Exchange, PST files, and Outlook.com.
- Includes pre-migration checklist, DNS/MX cutover instructions, and thorough post-migration validation steps.
- Provides deliverables templates: migration plan, user communication, admin runbook, and validation report.
- Lists common issues and solutions for troubleshooting.
